name: indicator_id
description: Identifier of the indicator the observation belongs to
observations: Foreign key to the au_abs_productivity indicator table

name: period
description: Productivity growth cycle the observation covers in YYYY-YY to YYYY-YY format
observations: ABS growth cycles run peak to peak in MFP, so they are of unequal length and are the ABS-preferred basis for comparing productivity growth over time

name: period_start_financial_year
description: Australian financial year the growth cycle starts in

name: period_end_financial_year
description: Australian financial year the growth cycle ends in

name: value
description: Observed value of the indicator over the growth cycle
observations: Usually a compound annual percentage change; the unit is given in the unit column of the indicator table, so no fixed measurement unit applies here
